evidence.what: burnt hay bales sitting in travel lanes
large flames and thick black smoke on right shoulder
blue tractor with raised tipped trailer stopped on shoulder
group of bystanders and stopped cars on right shoulder

verdict.summary: Large hay-bale fire on right shoulder ahead with debris in road, use caution.
verdict.details: Dashcam approaches large hay-bale fire on rural highway. Black smoke column visible ahead. Charred bales sit in travel lanes, intense orange flames burn multiple large bales on right shoulder. Blue tractor with tipped trailer stopped nearby, several cars pulled over, group of bystanders on shoulder. No emergency responders visible.
